remarks: BRAND NEW kitchen with quartz countertops, NEW washer and dryer, NEW bathroom vanities, and FRESH paint - All that's missing is YOU! 3-level townhouse on quiet Byram dead end street. Hardwood floors throughout! 2 parking spaces. Need a work-from-home space? The finished basement would be perfect! 1 cat is okay, 1 small or medium dog considered (extra pet rent), must be approved by landlord. Tenant is responsible for trash, utilities, and renter's insurance. Rent includes water & sewer. You'll love the location! Take a nice short 6 min stroll to Rosina's and other great restaurants! Also walking distance to Byram Park - where you'll find a beach, pool, boat club, clambake pavilion, playground, marina, and boat launch in addition to sports fields, tennis courts and walking trails. So much to love about 155 Pine St!
